thread:
sam: Heads up — after the 1.30 control-plane rollout in us-west-2, GPU nodepools (gpu-training-*) are not scaling up for queued jobs. Jobs stay Pending, autoscaler claims no compatible nodegroup.
marie: Can you paste the autoscaler logs? nodegroup names/labels? Also which autoscaler version are we running?
sam: autoscaler v1.24. Logs: ```I0318 12:03:45.123456 1 scale_up.go:210] NoCandidateNodeGroups: providerSpec parse failed: unexpected field 'capacityType' in MachinePoolSpec``` gpu nodepool label: `node.k8s.aws/instance-type=g4dn.xlarge`, provider spec used to have `capacityType: SPOT` (pre-upgrade) but CR now shows `capacity.type: spot` in the NodePool CR.
kai: Ah — upstream changed the managed nodegroup CRD field path during the kube/eks provider update. Autoscaler is still talking to the old path. That would make it think the GPU pools are on a different capacity type, so it won't pick them for scale-up.
devbot: deploy-bot: noted rollout event for clusters/us-west-2 control-plane @ 2026-03-18T12:00Z
marie: Is this just a parsing mismatch or also a semantic rename? If the autoscaler can be taught to fallback to the nested `capacity.type` we can hotfix without rolling back control-plane.
kai: Looks like a simple parse fallback. Two quick options: 1) patch autoscaler to attempt both fields; 2) run a k8s mutating script to copy `capacity.type` -> `capacityType` into NodePool spec for now.
jordan: I prefer option 1 for safety. I'll open a tiny PR to the autoscaler image that checks `.capacityType || .capacity.type` before matching. Can ship canary to one cluster.
sam: If PR takes too long we can patch nodepool with `kubectl patch nodepool gpu-training-usw2 -p '{"spec":{"capacityType":"SPOT"}}' --type=merge'` — but that's manual and error-prone for many pools.
marie: I'll prepare a playbook for the patch method as fallback. For now, jordan please canary the autoscaler image in staging then prod; kai can help with canary config.
kai: On it. I'll create a canary deployment in kube-system that only targets the us-west-2 cluster, scale down the old autoscaler, roll the new image with `--enable-fieldmap-fallback=true` env.
marie: Quick sanity check: GPU nodes have taints `nvidia.com/gpu=true:NoSchedule` and we had some concern about taint-based filtering earlier — this is definitely just field parsing, not taint logic.
sre-oncall: I'm watching GPU queue. Current pending pods: 12; backoff is increasing. If canary takes longer than 20m we should flip to the nodepatch fallback.
jordan: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/cluster-autoscaler/pull/382 — tiny parse fallback + unit tests. Image built: ghcr.io/redwood/cluster-autoscaler:fix/fieldmap-1912
kai: Deployed canary to staging. Observability: I'll hook up token-level latency graphs and autoscaler decision traces. If scale-up decisions pick gpu-training-*, we'll promote.
sam: Canary logs show `Parsed capacityType=SPOT (from capacity.type)` and scaleUp decision started for gpu-training-usw2.
marie: Promoting to canary-prod now for us-west-2 only. Rolling update window 10m.
devbot: deploy-bot: rollout started cluster-autoscaler fix/fieldmap-1912 -> prod/us-west-2 at 12:38Z
sre-oncall: Confirmed scale-up: 3 nodes provisioning, pods moving to ContainerCreating -> Running. Pending count down to 0.
marie: Thanks team. Follow-ups: 1) patch and GC script to remove manual `capacityType` copies after control-plane schema stabilizes; 2) add an autoscaler e2e that validates provider field permutations; 3) notify Partner infra (EKS) about the field rename causing customer-visible regressions.
sam: I'll add a postmortem note in /incidents and tag infra-ops for a rollback play if we see other clusters impacted.
jordan: PR merged, new stable image promoted. :thumbsup:
marie: Closing this thread — keeping runbook in eng-infra playbooks repo. If anyone sees drifts in other regions ping here.
